modalLead: A tidier Containers table, and the folders your containers keep their data in.

items.text: Bind mounts on the Disk tab. The host folders your containers mount, and who mounts each where. On Unraid that is your appdata, which the Volumes list never showed.
Three ports, then +N. A container with many ports keeps its row on one line; the rest open in a list.
An update is an arrow before the name. Names line up again, and long names and images stay on one line, whole on hover.
Group bands count their containers, as in Updates · 9.
